access.bulk: Advanced Corporation Search can export search results to CSV, but the official guidance warns broad searches can overload, time out or return errors and does not describe a complete bulk snapshot.
access.api: No official business-entity read API is documented.
access.search: Public corporation and advanced search require no login; search-result CSV is supported.

fields.summary: Public entity pages show business name, UBI, type, current status, principal office street/mailing addresses, expiration, jurisdiction and formation date, alongside registered-agent data that must be excluded; exact CSV schema and bounds are unpublished.

active_status_semantics: Current Status and expiration describe filed registry status; official guidance says statuses indicate filed documents, not verified current operation.
statewide_completeness: Advanced search can compile lists by type/status/dates, but no safe all-entity query, control total or complete extract contract is documented; inactive records older than ten years move out of the online system.
address_zip: Principal office street and mailing addresses are visible, but the CSV field contract and organization-control/physical-site semantics are unresolved; registered-agent addresses must be excluded.
automation_terms_fees: Public search/export needs no login, but official guidance calls for refined queries and provides no supported automation/rate contract. No fee is listed for search CSV.
redistribution: Public availability does not establish retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication or redistribution rights.
temporal_refresh: Records update through filings and annual reports; no complete snapshot cadence, change/deletion feed, replay window or checksum is published.

citations.evidence: Official corporation registry and filing-system scope.
Official public/advanced search, CSV export, fields/status semantics, broad-query limitations and historical-record boundary.
Official public-record field labels including principal addresses and registered agent.
Official no-login on-demand record access context.

strongest_next_action: Request a documented complete extract or bounded export contract with current person-free CSV schema, maximum/result controls, UBI lifecycle, statuses, address roles, counts, cadence, deletions/replay/checksums and reuse rights; do not automate advanced-search partitioning.
